Transformer attention is permutation-inv.zh:
Transformer 的注意力具有置换不变性：@@T0@@「狗咬人」@@T1@@
          与 @@T2@@「人咬狗」@@T3@@ 将产生完全相同的 logit。位置信息必须从别处注入。已有三大类方案胜出；本文在同一套坐标下展示这三者 —— 热力图、相似度矩阵、RoPE 旋转、外推曲线。
Transformer attention is permutation-inv.src: Transformer attention is permutation-invariant: "dog bites man" and "man bites dog" would produce identical logits. Position has to be injected from somewhere else. Three families have won; this article shows all three on the same axes — heatmap, similarity matrix, RoPE rotation, extrapolation curves.

Why attention forgets order.zh: 注意力为何会遗忘顺序

Plain attention computes\n $\\t.zh:
朴素注意力计算
          $\text{softmax}(QK^\top / \sqrt d)\, V$。每个输出词元都是对 @@T0@@所有@@T1@@ 输入词元的加权和 —— 但权重仅取决于 $Q$ 与 $K$ 的
          @@T2@@内容@@T3@@，而与它们的下标无关。
          置换输入序列，每一个注意力权重也随之被置换。输出的集合仍然是同一个集合。
Plain attention computes\n $\\t.src: Plain attention computes $\text{softmax}(QK^\top / \sqrt d)\, V$. Each output token is a weighted sum over all the input tokens — but the weights depend only on the content of $Q$ and $K$, not on their indices. Permute the input sequence and every attention weight is permuted along with it. The output set is the same set.

That symmetry is fatal for any task that.zh: 这一对称性对任何依赖顺序的任务都是致命的，而语言中所有有价值的任务都依赖顺序。已有三类修正方案胜出：
That symmetry is fatal for any task that.src:
That symmetry is fatal for any task that depends on order,
          which is every interesting task language has. Three
          families of fixes have prevailed:

@@T0@@Sinusoidal@@T1@@ (Vaswani et&nbsp;.zh: @@T0@@正弦式@@T1@@（Vaswani 等，2017）：为每个词元嵌入加上一条固定的波形。成本低，不含可学习参数。
@@T0@@Sinusoidal@@T1@@ (Vaswani et&nbsp;.src: Sinusoidal (Vaswani et al., 2017): add a fixed waveform to each token embedding. Cheap, no learned parameters.

@@T0@@RoPE@@T1@@ (Su et&nbsp;al., 2021):.zh: @@T0@@RoPE@@T1@@（Su 等，2021）：将 Q 与 K 按与位置成正比的角旋转。此时点积 $Q_i \cdot K_j$ 仅取决于偏移量 $j - i$。
@@T0@@RoPE@@T1@@ (Su et&nbsp;al., 2021):.src: RoPE (Su et al., 2021): rotate Q and K by an angle proportional to position. The dot product $Q_i \cdot K_j$ then depends only on the offset $j - i$.

@@T0@@ALiBi@@T1@@ (Press, Smith, Lewis,.zh: @@T0@@ALiBi@@T1@@（Press、Smith、Lewis，2022）：完全跳过嵌入。将线性惩罚 $-m \cdot |i - j|$ 加到注意力分数上。极其简单，外推性能良好。
@@T0@@ALiBi@@T1@@ (Press, Smith, Lewis,.src: ALiBi (Press, Smith, Lewis, 2022): skip embeddings entirely. Add a linear penalty $-m \cdot |i - j|$ to attention scores. Brutally simple, extrapolates well.

They differ along three axes that matter.zh: 它们在三个于规模化时至关重要的方面存在差异：参数数量、向比训练时更长序列外推的能力，以及计算成本。下面三节将分别让这些差异变得直观可感。
They differ along three axes that matter.src:
They differ along three axes that matter at scale:
          parameter count, ability to extrapolate to longer
          sequences than seen at training, and computational cost.
          Each of the three sections below makes those differences
          visceral.

Sinusoidal — one frequency per dimension.zh: 正弦式 —— 每个维度一个频率

Pick a sequence length and embedding dim.zh: 选择序列长度与嵌入维度。下方热力图展示完整的位置编码张量：行对应位置 $0, 1, \ldots, L-1$，列对应嵌入维度 $0, 1, \ldots, d-1$。偶数列为正弦，奇数列为余弦。每个维度各有其频率，从 $1$ 到 $1 / 10000$ 按几何级数分布。
Pick a sequence length and embedding dim.src:
Pick a sequence length and embedding dimension. The
          heatmap below shows the full positional encoding tensor:
          rows are positions $0, 1, \ldots, L-1$, columns are
          embedding dimensions $0, 1, \ldots, d-1$. Even columns are
          sines; odd columns are cosines. Each dimension has its own
          frequency, spaced geometrically from $1$ down to
          $1 / 10000$.

positional-encoding matrix (rows = posit.zh: 位置编码矩阵（行 = 位置，列 = 嵌入维度）
positional-encoding matrix (rows = posit.src: positional-encoding matrix (rows = position, columns = embedding dim)

@@T0@@Reading the picture.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@如何解读该图。@@T1@@
            最左侧的列振荡很快（高频，用于区分相邻位置）。最右侧的列振荡很慢（低频，编码宽广的位置区段）。二者共同构成一个「二进制时钟」，使每个位置都有独特的指纹。
@@T0@@Reading the picture.@@T1@@\n.src: Reading the picture. Leftmost columns oscillate fast (high-frequency, distinguishing neighbours). Rightmost columns oscillate slowly (low-frequency, encoding broad position bands). Together they form a "binary clock" where every position has a unique fingerprint.

The headline property: $\\mathrm{PE}_{\\.zh: 其核心性质在于：对任意偏移 $k$，$\mathrm{PE}_{\text{pos}+k}$ 都是 $\mathrm{PE}_{\text{pos}}$ 的固定线性函数。因此 transformer 可以通过一个学习得到的线性映射，从绝对编码中@@T0@@恢复出相对位置@@T1@@。这正是最初论证固定正弦式编码能与学习式查表同样有效的原因。
The headline property: $\\mathrm{PE}_{\\.src: The headline property: $\mathrm{PE}_{\text{pos}+k}$ is a fixed linear function of $\mathrm{PE}_{\text{pos}}$ for any offset $k$. So a transformer can recover relative position from the absolute encoding via a learned linear map. This was the original argument for why a fixed sinusoid would work as well as a learned table.

Below: the cosine similarity between eve.zh: 下图：每一对位置之间的余弦相似度。对角线为 1（每个位置与自身）；偏离对角线的衰减程度反映了相邻位置的可区分程度。
Below: the cosine similarity between eve.src:
Below: the cosine similarity between every pair of
          positions. Diagonal is 1 (each position with itself); the
          dropoff away from the diagonal tells you how
          distinguishable nearby positions are.

cosine similarity matrix between positio.zh: 位置间余弦相似度矩阵 ⟨PE@@T0@@i@@T1@@, PE@@T2@@j@@T3@@⟩
cosine similarity matrix between positio.src: cosine similarity matrix between positions ⟨PE<sub>i</sub>, PE<sub>j</sub>⟩

Higher values = positions look similar t.zh: 取值越高，表示这些位置在注意力看来越相似。对角线附近的平滑衰减正是我们想要的 —— 靠近的位置彼此易混淆，相距较远的位置则能被清晰区分。
Higher values = positions look similar t.src:
Higher values = positions look similar to attention.
            Smooth fall-off near the diagonal is exactly what we
            want — close positions are confusable; far ones are
            cleanly distinguished.

Sinusoidal PE has a known weakness: it's.zh: 正弦式位置编码有一个已知的弱点：它只在嵌入上加一次，注意力层必须耗费容量从该和中恢复相对位置。RoPE 将这一点颠倒过来：它不@@T0@@加@@T1@@位置，而是@@T2@@旋转@@T3@@查询与键。
Sinusoidal PE has a known weakness: it's.src: Sinusoidal PE has a known weakness: it's added to the embedding once, and the attention layer has to spend capacity recovering relative position from the sum. RoPE inverts this: instead of adding position, it rotates the queries and keys.

Pair adjacent dimensions $(2i, 2i+1)$. F.zh:
将相邻维度配对为 $(2i, 2i+1)$。对位置 $\text{pos}$，把该二维子向量旋转一个角度
          $\theta_i = \text{pos} \cdot 10000^{-2i/d}$。于是，位置 $i$ 的旋转后查询与位置 $j$ 的旋转后键之间的点积，便仅成为@@T0@@差值@@T1@@ $j - i$ 的函数。
Pair adjacent dimensions $(2i, 2i+1)$. F.src: Pair adjacent dimensions $(2i, 2i+1)$. For position $\text{pos}$, rotate that 2D sub-vector by an angle $\theta_i = \text{pos} \cdot 10000^{-2i/d}$. The dot product between a rotated query at position $i$ and a rotated key at position $j$ then becomes a function only of the difference $j - i$.

two rotated query/key vectors (one 2D su.zh: 两个旋转后的查询/键向量（一个二维子对）

dot product Q@@T0@@i@@T1@@ · K@@T2@@j@@T.zh: 当 i、j 滑动时点积 Q@@T0@@i@@T1@@ · K@@T2@@j@@T3@@ 的变化
dot product Q@@T0@@i@@T1@@ · K@@T2@@j@@T.src: dot product Q<sub>i</sub> · K<sub>j</sub> as i, j slide

The headline: change positions 1 and 2 t.zh: 核心结论：将位置 1、2 改为 (5, 15) 或 (20, 30) —— 两者偏移量均为 10。点积@@T0@@完全相同@@T1@@。RoPE 已将绝对位置从注意力分数中分离出去，只留下相对位置。
The headline: change positions 1 and 2 t.src: The headline: change positions 1 and 2 to (5, 15) or (20, 30) — the offset is 10 in both. The dot product is identical. RoPE has factored absolute position out of the attention score; only relative position remains.

@@T0@@Why this matters for long context..zh:
@@T0@@为何这对长上下文至关重要。@@T1@@
          使用纯粹的绝对编码时，每个位置都有各不相同的嵌入。在位置 $0$–$2047$ 上训练、在位置 $4096$ 上测试，则该 $4096$ 的嵌入从未出现过。
          而使用 RoPE 时，只有@@T2@@相对@@T3@@偏移进入点积。无论绝对位置是 $(0, 100)$ 还是 $(5000, 5100)$，偏移为 100 处的推理表现都相同。
@@T0@@Why this matters for long context..src: Why this matters for long context. With pure absolute encodings, every position has a distinct embedding. Train on positions $0$–$2047$, test on position $4096$, and the embedding for $4096$ has never been seen. With RoPE, only the relative offset enters the dot product. Inference at offset 100 looks the same whether the absolute positions are $(0, 100)$ or $(5000, 5100)$.

ALiBi — a linear penalty on distance.zh: ALiBi —— 对距离的线性惩罚
ALiBi — a linear penalty on distance.src: ALiBi — a linear penalty on distance

The simplest of the three. Skip position.zh: 三者中最简单的一种。完全不在嵌入层使用位置编码。将固定偏置 $-m \cdot |i - j|$ 加到注意力分数上，其中斜率 $m$ 按注意力头手工设定（各头之间构成等比数列 —— 第 $h$ 个头使用 $m_h = 2^{-8h/H}$）。
The simplest of the three. Skip position.src:
The simplest of the three. Skip positional encodings at
          the embedding layer entirely. Add a fixed bias
          $-m \cdot |i - j|$ to the attention score, where the
          slope $m$ is hand-set per head (a geometric sequence
          across heads — head $h$ uses $m_h = 2^{-8h/H}$).

The matrix below shows the bias on a 32×.zh: 下方矩阵展示某个头在 32×32 注意力网格上的偏置。选择一个斜率。该偏置恒为负值并随距离增大：它惩罚对远处词元的关注 —— 等价地说，它使每个词元偏向关注其邻近词元。
The matrix below shows the bias on a 32×.src:
The matrix below shows the bias on a 32×32 attention
          grid for one head. Pick a slope. The bias is uniformly
          negative and grows with distance: it penalises attending
          to faraway tokens — equivalently, biases each token
          toward attending to its neighbours.

ALiBi bias matrix (lower-triangular for.zh: ALiBi 偏置矩阵（因果注意力下为下三角）
ALiBi bias matrix (lower-triangular for.src: ALiBi bias matrix (lower-triangular for causal attention)

Different heads use different slopes; so.zh: 不同的头使用不同的斜率；一些头关注局部上下文（斜率较陡），另一些关注宽泛上下文（斜率较缓）。该安排在训练时即固定，从不参与训练。
Different heads use different slopes; so.src:
Different heads use different slopes; some heads focus
              on local context (steep slope), others on broad context (gentle
              slope). The schedule is fixed at training time and never trained.

ALiBi's selling point: extrapolation. Th.zh: ALiBi 的卖点在于外推。偏置矩阵中没有任何量依赖绝对位置 —— 只依赖 $|i - j|$。基于长度 2048 训练的模型可部署到长度 16384，其所见相对位置信号毫无退化。
ALiBi's selling point: extrapolation. Th.src:
ALiBi's selling point: extrapolation. There's nothing in
          the bias matrix that depends on absolute position — only
          on $|i - j|$. The model trained on length 2048 can be
          deployed at length 16384 with no degradation in the
          relative-position signal it sees.

Extrapolation — train at 2k, test at 32k.zh: 外推 —— 在 2k 上训练，在 32k 上测试

The benchmark that put RoPE and ALiBi on.zh: 让 RoPE 与 ALiBi 崭露头角的评测方式：以最大上下文 2048 个词元训练一个 transformer；在 4k、8k、16k、32k 处评估困惑度。凡死记了绝对位置 $0$–$2047$ 的方案，在超过 2048 后便会断崖式下跌。而仅使用相对信息的方案则会平缓退化。
The benchmark that put RoPE and ALiBi on.src:
The benchmark that put RoPE and ALiBi on the map: train
          a transformer with a max context of 2048 tokens; evaluate
          perplexity at 4k, 8k, 16k, 32k. A scheme that has
          memorised absolute positions $0$–$2047$ will fall off a
          cliff past 2048. A scheme that uses only relative
          information will degrade gracefully.

Below: the three positional-encoding sch.zh: 下图：三种位置编码方案在一个合成的「相对位置召回」任务上的得分。指标为：模型在训练时（≤ 2k）对距离 $\Delta$ 处某查询的表示，与测试时（至多 32k）相同偏移处的表示之间的余弦相似度。高且平稳为佳；下降则不佳。这些数值重现了 Press 等（2022）的定性发现：
Below: the three positional-encoding sch.src:
Below: the three positional-encoding schemes scored on a
          synthetic "relative-position recall" task. The metric is
          the cosine similarity between the model's representation
          of a query at distance $\Delta$ in training (≤ 2k) versus
          the same offset at test (up to 32k). High and flat is
          good; falling is bad. The numbers reproduce the
          qualitative finding from Press et al. (2022):

trained 0–2k. drops sharply past 2k — mo.zh: 在 0–2k 上训练。超过 2k 后急剧下降 —— 模型从未见过位置 4000。
trained 0–2k. drops sharply past 2k — mo.src: trained 0–2k. drops sharply past 2k — model has never seen position 4000.

only relative offsets matter; degrades g.zh: 只有相对偏移起作用；随着角度绕回而逐渐退化。
only relative offsets matter; degrades g.src: only relative offsets matter; degrades gradually as the angle wraps.

flat. nothing in the bias depends on abs.zh: 保持平稳。偏置中没有任何量依赖绝对位置。
flat. nothing in the bias depends on abs.src: flat. nothing in the bias depends on absolute position.

@@T0@@The pattern.@@T1@@\n Sinu.zh:
@@T0@@规律。@@T1@@
          正弦式编码在超过训练长度后崩溃，因为其高频维度会以模型从未优化过的形式绕回。RoPE 退化，是因为当位置超过
          $\pi / \theta_{\min}$ 时其旋转角会绕回。ALiBi 之所以不退化，是因为其 $-m \cdot |i - j|$ 的性质始终不变：在 $\Delta = 10000$ 处，它仍然只是一个略大一些的负偏置。
@@T0@@The pattern.@@T1@@\n Sinu.src: The pattern. Sinusoidal collapses past the training length because its high-frequency dimensions wrap around in ways the model has never optimised against. RoPE degrades because its rotation angles wrap when positions exceed $\pi / \theta_{\min}$. ALiBi doesn't degrade because its $-m \cdot |i - j|$ never changes character: at $\Delta = 10000$ it's still just a slightly bigger negative bias.

yes (with NTK / YaRN tricks).zh: 是（借助 NTK / YaRN 技巧）

The post-2022 consensus: @@T0@@RoPE@@T1@.zh:
2022 年之后的共识是：@@T0@@RoPE@@T1@@ 是自回归 LLM 的现代默认选择；当外推能力为首要考虑且模型为单任务时，则倾向于
          @@T2@@ALiBi@@T3@@。学习式绝对位置属于遗留基线；新模型无人采用。
The post-2022 consensus: @@T0@@RoPE@@T1@.src: The post-2022 consensus: RoPE is the modern default for autoregressive LLMs; ALiBi is preferred when extrapolation is the top concern and the model is single-task. Learned absolute is the legacy baseline; nobody picks it for a new model.

NTK-aware scaling, YaRN, and dynamic NTK.zh: NTK 感知缩放、YaRN 与动态 NTK 都是将经 RoPE 训练的模型扩展至超出其训练长度的技术。它们通过重新缩放基频，使旋转角保持在已见过的范围内。这些方法都并非没有代价 —— 总存在某种精度权衡，长上下文基准（LongBench、Needle in a Haystack、RULER）对此有充分记录。
NTK-aware scaling, YaRN, and dynamic NTK.src:
NTK-aware scaling, YaRN, and dynamic NTK are all
          techniques for extending RoPE-trained models beyond their
          training length. They rescale the base frequency to keep
          rotation angles in the seen range. None of them comes free
          — there is always some accuracy trade-off, well-documented
          in the long-context benchmarks (LongBench, Needle in a
          Haystack, RULER).

\"RoPE has no parameters.\" → true, but..zh: 「RoPE 没有参数。」→ 确实如此，但……

...the rotation base $\\theta = 10000$ i.zh:
……旋转基频 $\theta = 10000$ 是一个超参数，选择不当会损害长上下文表现。
            Llama-3 采用 $\theta = 500{,}000$，以减缓远距离处角度的绕回。NTK 感知缩放可视为在推理时动态地选取 $\theta$。
...the rotation base $\\theta = 10000$ i.src:
...the rotation base $\theta = 10000$ is a hyperparameter
            and choosing it badly hurts long-context behaviour.
            Llama-3 uses $\theta = 500{,}000$ to make the angles
            wrap less aggressively at long distances. NTK-aware
            scaling can be viewed as dynamically picking $\theta$
            at inference time.

\"ALiBi extrapolates perfectly to infini.zh: 「ALiBi 能完美外推到无限上下文。」

ALiBi degrades less than sinusoidal or R.zh: ALiBi 的退化程度小于正弦式或 RoPE，但它确实会退化：模型只见过偏置幅度至多 $2048 \cdot m$ 的注意力分数。超出该范围后，模型的行为依赖于「略大的偏置具有相同定性效果」这一假设 —— 这在实践中大致成立，但并不完美。
ALiBi degrades less than sinusoidal or R.src:
ALiBi degrades less than sinusoidal or RoPE, but it
            does degrade: the model has only seen attention scores
            with bias magnitudes up to $2048 \cdot m$. Past that
            range, the model's behaviour relies on the assumption
            that a slightly larger bias has the same qualitative
            effect — which holds in practice but not perfectly.

\"Positional encoding is decoupled from.zh: 「位置编码与注意力是解耦的。」

Sinusoidal encoding adds to the embeddin.zh:
正弦式编码在注意力看到任何内容之前，仅向嵌入加一次；从这个意义上说它是解耦的。
            RoPE 位于@@T0@@注意力计算内部@@T1@@（旋转 Q 与 K）。ALiBi 同样位于@@T2@@注意力内部@@T3@@
            （对 logit 施加偏置）。趋势一直是将位置信息更深地推入注意力机制之中，而非将其置于外部。
Sinusoidal encoding adds to the embeddin.src: Sinusoidal encoding adds to the embedding once, before attention sees anything; in that sense it is decoupled. RoPE is inside the attention computation (rotates Q and K). ALiBi is also inside attention (a bias on logits). The trend has been to push position deeper into the attention machinery, not keep it outside.

meta.title: 位置编码 —— 正弦式、RoPE、ALiBi
meta.tagline: 注意力具有置换不变性。三种打破该对称性的方法 —— 可视化呈现。
meta.summary: Transformer 的注意力没有顺序概念：「狗咬人」与「人咬狗」会得到完全相同的 logit。位置必须从外部注入。已有三类方案胜出 —— 正弦式（加到嵌入上）、RoPE（旋转查询与键）、ALiBi（对注意力分数施加线性惩罚）。三者均以实时演示呈现：热力图、点积相似度矩阵，以及延伸至 32k 词元的外推曲线。
highlights: 正弦式热力图，配有序列长度与 d_model 的实时滑块 —— 观察每个维度上的频带分布。
每一对位置之间的点积相似度矩阵；观察随着 |i − j| 增大，对角线如何变得锐利。
把 RoPE 视为二维旋转：拖动位置，观察 q 与 k 按与位置成正比的角旋转；所得点积只取决于相对偏移。
ALiBi 的线性偏置矩阵叠加在注意力之上；选择某个头，观察其斜率如何决定它惩罚距离的强度。
外推面板：在 2k 词元上训练，在 32k 上测试 —— 正弦式崩溃，RoPE 漂移，ALiBi 保持稳定。
ES 667 第 14 讲演示（Transformer 架构）；与注意力一文配合，可理解底层的 QKV 机制。
